title: Unreal Editor tooling and viewport overhead
fix_rationale: Editor tooling, level editor ticking, and viewport client logic do not run in packaged game builds.
evidence_template: {timer} consumed {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) servicing Unreal Editor tooling and viewport client.

fixes.text: Profile using a packaged Development or Test build to measure true player performance without editor overhead.
In editor: Close auxiliary tabs, output logs, asset editors, and extra viewports.
Run editor PIE in 'Standalone Game' mode to isolate game execution from editor tool ticking.

verify: Profile a packaged game build to confirm Editor-specific tick overhead is eliminated.
caveats: This is an editor profiling artifact and will not impact standalone or packaged game builds.
